title: FLOWSTEP: A Framework for Learning to Predict GitHub Actions Workflow STEPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD) are fundamental to modern software development, yet configuring pipelines such as GitHub Actions (GHA) workflows remains complex and error-prone. Recent work has explored Transformer-based models for GHA workflow recommendation, but existing approaches typically model workflow steps as a single homogeneous generation task. This formulation overlooks a key distinction: reusable Actions are structured, ecosystem-level components, whereas project-specific Scripts encode local build, test, and deployment semantics. Consequently, current models struggle to capture the different forms of knowledge required for accurate workflow completion. In this work, we present FLOWSTEP, a framework for GHA workflow step completion that explicitly distinguishes between Action and Script generation. translated_title: FLOWSTEP：一个学习预测 GitHub Actions 工作流步骤的框架
translated_abstract: 持续集成与持续交付（CI/CD）是现代软件开发的基础，然而配置诸如 GitHub Actions（GHA）工作流之类的流水线仍然复杂且容易出错。近期研究已探索了基于 Transformer 的模型用于 GHA 工作流推荐，但现有方法通常将工作流步骤建模为单一的同质生成任务。这种建模方式忽略了一个关键区别：可复用的 Actions 是结构化的生态系统级组件，而项目特定的 Scripts 则编码了本地构建、测试和部署的语义。因此，当前模型难以捕获准确完成工作流所需的不同形式的知识。在本工作中，我们提出了 FLOWSTEP，一个用于 GHA 工作流步骤补全的框架，它明确区分 Action 生成与 Script 生成。FLOWSTEP 将大语言模型（LLMs）与对比学习相结合，以更好地捕获语义关系……
tldr: FLOWSTEP 通过明确区分可复用 Action 与项目特定 Script 两类工作流步骤，并结合大语言模型与对比学习，显著提升了 GitHub Actions 工作流步骤自动补全的准确性。
en_tdlr: FLOWSTEP combines LLMs with contrastive learning and explicitly distinguishes between reusable Actions and project-specific Scripts to improve the accuracy of GitHub Actions workflow step completion.
